title: Tagging Verification
description: Global/core iDoXs report showing daily field tagging verification by region, district, territory, PE, and visit date, modeled after legacy rptTaggingVerification.php.

source.sql: with base as ( select coalesce(nullif(ltrim(rtrim(cast(d.REGION_ID as varchar(128)))), ''), '') as region_id, ltrim(rtrim(cast(pi.DISTRICT_ID as varchar(128)))) as district_id, ltrim(rtrim(cast(i.TERRITORY_ID as varchar(128)))) as territory_id, ltrim(rtrim(cast(pi.PSR_ID as varchar(128)))) as psr_id, nullif(ltrim(rtrim(coalesce(pi.PSR_NAME, concat(isnull(p.FIRST_NAME, ''), ' ', isnull(p.LAST_NAME, ''))))), '') as psr_name, convert(date, i.VISIT_DATE) as visit_date, min(i.VISIT_DATE) as first_visit_dt, max(i.VISIT_DATE) as last_visit_dt, sum(case when convert(varchar(8), i.VISIT_DATE, 108) <> '00:00:00' then 1 else 0 end) as mobile_count, sum(case when convert(varchar(12), i.VISIT_DATE, 114) in ('06:00:00:000', '15:00:00:000', '00:00:00:000') then 1 else 0 end) as online_count, count_big(*) as total_call_day from [dbo].[PSR_ITINERARY] pi join [dbo].[ITINERARY] i on pi.PSR_ID = i.PSR_ID and pi.ITINERARY_DATE = i.ITINERARY_DATE and pi.TERRITORY_ID = i.TERRITORY_ID left join [dbo].[PSR] p on pi.PSR_ID = p.PSR_ID left join [dbo].[TERRITORY] t on ltrim(rtrim(cast(i.TERRITORY_ID as varchar(128)))) = ltrim(rtrim(cast(t.TERRITORY_ID as varchar(128)))) left join [dbo].[DISTRICT] d on ltrim(rtrim(cast(coalesce(t.DISTRICT_ID, pi.DISTRICT_ID) as varchar(128)))) = ltrim(rtrim(cast(d.DISTRICT_ID as varchar(128)))) where pi.[MONTH] = @periodCode and pi.[YEAR] = @fiscalYear and i.VISIT_DATE is not null {{territoryPredicate:i.TERRITORY_ID}} group by coalesce(nullif(ltrim(rtrim(cast(d.REGION_ID as varchar(128)))), ''), ''), ltrim(rtrim(cast(pi.DISTRICT_ID as varchar(128)))), ltrim(rtrim(cast(i.TERRITORY_ID as varchar(128)))), ltrim(rtrim(cast(pi.PSR_ID as varchar(128)))), nullif(ltrim(rtrim(coalesce(pi.PSR_NAME, concat(isnull(p.FIRST_NAME, ''), ' ', isnull(p.LAST_NAME, ''))))), ''), convert(date, i.VISIT_DATE) ), aggregated as ( select region_id, district_id, territory_id, psr_id, psr_name, visit_date, min(first_visit_dt) as first_visit_dt, max(last_visit_dt) as last_visit_dt, sum(mobile_count) as mobile_count, sum(online_count) as online_count, sum(total_call_day) as total_call_day, grouping(region_id) as g_region, grouping(district_id) as g_district, grouping(territory_id) as g_territory, grouping(psr_id) as g_psr, grouping(psr_name) as g_psr_name, grouping(visit_date) as g_visit_date, min(region_id) as __sort_region, min(district_id) as __sort_district, min(territory_id) as __sort_territory, min(visit_date) as __sort_visit_date, min(psr_name) as __sort_psr_name from base group by grouping sets ( (region_id, district_id, territory_id, psr_id, psr_name, visit_date), (region_id, district_id, territory_id), (region_id, district_id), (region_id), () ) ) select top 5000 case when g_region = 1 then '' else isnull(region_id, '') end as region, case when g_district = 1 then '' else isnull(district_id, '') end as district, case when g_region = 1 then '**** GRAND TOTAL ****' when g_district = 1 then concat('**** ', isnull(region_id, ''), ' sub-total') when g_territory = 1 then concat('**** ', isnull(district_id, ''), ' sub-total') when g_psr = 1 then concat('**** ', isnull(territory_id, ''), ' sub-total') else isnull(territory_id, '') end as territory, case when g_psr = 1 then '' else concat('(', isnull(psr_id, ''), ') ', isnull(psr_name, '')) end as pe_name, case when g_psr = 1 then '' else 'details' end as details, case when g_visit_date = 1 then null else visit_date end as visit_date, case when g_visit_date = 1 then '' else convert(varchar(12), first_visit_dt, 114) end as first_visit, case when g_visit_date = 1 then '' else convert(varchar(12), last_visit_dt, 114) end as last_visit, case when g_visit_date = 1 then '' else concat(cast(datediff(minute, first_visit_dt, last_visit_dt) / 60 as varchar(10)), ':', right(concat('0', cast(datediff(minute, first_visit_dt, last_visit_dt) % 60 as varchar(2))), 2)) end as hours_on_field, cast(mobile_count as int) as mobile_count, cast(online_count as int) as online_count, cast(total_call_day as int) as total_call_day, case when g_region = 1 then 'grand-total' when g_district = 1 then 'region-total' when g_territory = 1 then 'district-total' when g_psr = 1 then 'territory-total' else 'detail' end as __rowType, isnull(__sort_region, '') as __sort_region, case when g_district = 1 and g_region = 0 then 1 else 0 end as __sort_region_total, isnull(__sort_district, '') as __sort_district, case when g_territory = 1 and g_district = 0 then 1 else 0 end as __sort_district_total, isnull(__sort_territory, '') as __sort_territory, case when g_psr = 1 and g_territory = 0 then 1 else 0 end as __sort_territory_total, isnull(__sort_visit_date, '9999-12-31') as __sort_visit_date, isnull(__sort_psr_name, '') as __sort_psr_name from aggregated order by case when g_region = 1 then 1 else 0 end, __sort_region, __sort_region_total, __sort_district, __sort_district_total, __sort_territory, __sort_territory_total, __sort_visit_date, __sort_psr_name

businessFormulas.label: Mobile Count
businessFormulas.description: Legacy mobile count: visit rows whose visit timestamp is not midnight.
businessFormulas.formula: sum(case when CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), visit_date, 108) <> '00:00:00' then 1 else 0 end)

businessFormulas.label: Online Count
businessFormulas.description: Legacy online count: visit rows with legacy sync/time sentinel values 06:00, 15:00, or 00:00.
businessFormulas.formula: sum(case when CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), visit_date, 114) in ('06:00:00:000','15:00:00:000','00:00:00:000') then 1 else 0 end)

businessFormulas.label: Total Call / Day
businessFormulas.description: Total itinerary call rows for the PE/territory/date group.

dataSourceDefinition.grain: region + district + territory + PE + visit date, with territory/district/region/grand totals
dataSourceDefinition.notes: Modern equivalent of legacy rptTaggingVerification.php. The old report displayed a Details hyperlink into rptTaggingVerificationDetail; DoXs2 initially emits a text placeholder until drilldown links are added to the report renderer.
